Diff audit fixes: a password goes only to the key its server proved (a join by address that sends one from then on names that key, never after the localhost fallback); a join waiting for the list, the sign-in or Join anyway keeps its password and Cancel drops it; a key-only join waits for the fresh list (the cached one or a favorite after 8 s) and says so when the list could not be downloaded; Retry is gone where it would fail the same (a stale list's key - Go back refreshes it); quick play on a list that failed takes only servers answering a ping; favorites keep a server's public address, never one in the player's network; Local takes the first look only in its first 2 s. The server key's kind comes from the config files (canon), so a ranked autostart changed over RCON never changes it - multi-instance ones and tournament matches forced as before, each tournament match its own key, and a damaged server.key starts no tournament either; --print-server-key prints the same, at most 20 per kind. A 401 on a match report says loudly which key the site does not know. An unlink learned during a ranked match waits for its end. The unlink page is signed by the key, the link page signed anew every time it opens (Open it again is never too old), a blocked web tab is forgotten on Cancel, the avatar fetch has its 3 s on browsers without AbortSignal.timeout. Connect targets take a key with 0x and pasted spaces. The download bandwidth counted the bytes since the last call (it was always 0). yojimbo: a cheaper used-cookie check, another key fails after 3 s of an attempt. local-testing: link_flow_test for the signed unlink and the results of refused pages.
